injuries.longComment: After 13 seasons, 10 All-Star nods, two MVPs and a championship, Antetokounmpo will take his talents to South Beach. The superstar forward appeared in just 36 regular-season games in 2025-26 due to several injuries, averaging 27.6 points, 9.8 rebounds, 5.4 assists, 0.9 steals and 0.7 blocks in 28.9 minutes per showing. He'll now form a formidable pairing with Bam Adebayo in the Miami frontcourt as the Bucks navigate life without their franchise cornerstone.
injuries.shortComment: The Bucks traded Antetokounmpo (knee) and Bobby Portis (wrist) to the Miami Heat on Monday in exchange for Tyler Herro (foot), Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez, Kasparas Jakucionis, three first-round picks, one pick swap and a second-round pick, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
